title: dispatch bounds a headless worker's spend, not only its turns, since subagent work escapes --max-turns
goal: backlog.py dispatch passes a spend cap to the headless worker (claude -p --max-budget-usd, which the kb cites as a print-mode cap) from a setting or flag the operator sets, and the brief names it, so a worker that fans out to subagents stops at a known cost. SP-qjn563cf: the goal research worker ST-pnr4zyni used 54 of its 200 turns but cost 38.89 USD per its result JSON, against about 4 USD for the 301-turn SP-ajcomz6d research worker; the cap's value is the operator's call, asked as a gate when the item is planned.
